caveats.statement: The frpm table has separate columns for K-12 and ages 5-17 enrollment; using the wrong column will give incorrect counts.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NULL OR `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` IS NULL;

caveats.statement: The cards table has NULL values in power column; queries for 'cards without power' must include both NULL and '*'.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power IS NULL OR power = '*';

caveats.statement: The yearmonth table stores dates as YYYYMM integers; string functions or date parsing may be needed to extract year and month.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT Date FROM yearmonth LIMIT 5;

caveats.statement: The customers table Currency column uses 'EUR' for euro; queries for 'paid in euro' must filter Currency = 'EUR'.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Currency = 'EUR';

caveats.statement: The account frequency values are in Czech; 'POPLATEK TYDNE' means weekly issuance and 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' means issuance after transaction.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT frequency FROM account;

caveats.statement: 贷款状态用单字母代码记录,C表示正常还款,统计'无问题'贷款需按status='C'过滤
caveats.check_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM loan GROUP BY status

caveats.statement: 对账单频率用捷克语代码记录,需映射为MESICNE(月)/TYDNE(周)/PO OBRATU(交易后)
caveats.check_sql: SELECT frequency, COUNT(*) FROM account GROUP BY frequency

caveats.statement: 交易类型用捷克语代码,VYBER表示现金取款
caveats.check_sql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) FROM trans GROUP BY type

caveats.statement: 地区名称与区域分别存在district表的A2、A3列,平均工资在A11列,需按列取值
caveats.check_sql: SELECT A2, A3, A11 FROM district LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: 车手全名需拼接forename与surname,单列查询会漏掉姓名
caveats.check_sql: SELECT forename, surname FROM drivers LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: 圈速time为字符串格式,比较快慢应使用milliseconds数值列
caveats.check_sql: SELECT time, milliseconds FROM lapTimes LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: 国籍存在同义写法(如Dutch与Netherlandic),过滤时需覆盖多种写法
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT nationality FROM drivers

caveats.statement: 活动日期为字符串,取年份需用前4位或日期函数
caveats.check_sql: SELECT event_date FROM event LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: 预算与支出分属budget和expense两表,按活动关联时需通过link_to_event/link_to_budget连接
caveats.check_sql: SELECT b.budget_id, e.expense_id FROM budget b JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_budget=b.budget_id LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Patient Description may be NULL, so 'no data recorded' must use IS NULL
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Description IS NULL

caveats.statement: Income source values may vary in case or spelling, so filter carefully
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT source FROM income

caveats.statement: Event status and type values may have inconsistent casing
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT status, type FROM event

caveats.statement: Patient Birthday may be stored as text, requiring date parsing for age computation
caveats.check_sql: SELECT Birthday FROM Patient LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Patient lab values live in Laboratory while demographics live in Patient; joining without ID linkage can multiply rows, so counts must use DISTINCT ID
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS lab_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS distinct_ids FROM Laboratory

caveats.statement: Element symbols are stored lowercase; comparing to uppercase yields zero matches
caveats.check_sql: SELECT element, COUNT(*) FROM atom GROUP BY element ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

caveats.statement: Bond type uses '-' for single and '#' for triple; other symbols may exist and must be excluded
caveats.check_sql: SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type

caveats.statement: Molecule label uses '+' and '-' only; other values would break carcinogenic ratios
caveats.check_sql: SELECT label, COUNT(*) FROM molecule GROUP BY label

caveats.statement: Anti-centromere and anti-SSB results mix '-' and '+-' for normal; filtering only '-' undercounts
caveats.check_sql: SELECT CENTROMEA, COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory GROUP BY CENTROMEA

caveats.statement: Anti-Scl70 normal values appear as 'negative' or '0'; numeric comparison fails
caveats.check_sql: SELECT SC170, COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory GROUP BY SC170

caveats.statement: Cholesterol threshold uses T-CHO with a hyphen in the column name and requires backticks
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory WHERE `T-CHO` >= 250
